title: ChatGPT aur Codex ka ek hi usage pool - December se kya badlega
content:
Agar aap ChatGPT aur Codex dono use karte ho,
toh December se aapka hisaab badalne wala hai.
And most people won't notice until they hit the limit.
OpenAI ne apna Help Center article update kiya hai.
Starting in December,
Plus, Pro aur Business plans ka usage allowance
ChatGPT aur Codex ke beech SHARED hoga.
Matlab 2 alag limits nahi.
1 hi pool.
Aur ye pool TOKENS mein measure hoga.
Token matlab text ke chhote tukde
jo model padhta aur likhta hai.
Ab yahan pe ek important baat.
Kitna allowance use hoga,
ye depend karega aap kaunsa model chunte ho
aur task kitna heavy hai.
More advanced models and complex tasks use more of your allowance.
Lekin ek good news bhi hai.
Instant chat is pool se NAHI katega.
Normal quick sawaal-jawab free side pe rahega.
Toh ye kyun ho raha hai?
OpenAI kehta hai ki wo Work ki agentic capabilities
main ChatGPT experience mein la raha hai.
Jab chat aur agent ek hi jagah aa gaye,
toh limit bhi ek ho gayi.
Ab practical part.
Ise smartly use kaise karein.
Step 1.
Settings mein Usage section dekho.
Wahan combined remaining usage aur reset time dikhega.
Step 2.
Har kaam ke liye sabse bada model mat chuno.
Simple sawaal ke liye Instant use karo,
kyunki wo pool se nahi katta.
Step 3.
Heavy model sirf tab use karo
jab task sach mein complex ho,
jaise bada code refactor ya lambi research.
Step 4.
Maan lo aap din mein ChatGPT pe research karte ho
aur shaam ko Codex se coding.
Ab dono ek hi budget se katenge.
So plan your heavy tasks, don't waste them on small edits.
Aur agar limit khatam ho gayi,
OpenAI ke hisaab se aap reset ka wait kar sakte ho,
plan upgrade kar sakte ho,
ya credits khareed sakte ho.
Ek baat clear kar doon.
OpenAI ne abhi exact December date
aur har plan ke token amounts publish nahi kiye hain.
So don't panic, just watch your usage.
Mera take simple hai.
AI ab unlimited buffet nahi raha.
Ye ek budget hai.
Jo log model ko task ke hisaab se choose karna seekh lenge,
wahi zyada kaam nikalenge, same price mein.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
